notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two coat-closet leaves and two laundry-closet leaves are treated separately because they are manipulated sequentially. Their exact closing order and midpoint assignments are less certain because the paired doors overlap and partly occlude one another.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entryway, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet doors, two laundry-closet doors, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
